Definition: The incorporation of iron into a 3Fe-2S cluster by tris-L-cysteinyl L-cysteine persulfido L-glutamato L-histidino L-serinyl nickel triiron disulfide trioxide.
Synonyms: iron incorporation into iron-sulphur cluster via tris-L-cysteinyl L-cysteine persulphido L-glutamato L-histidino L-serinyl nickel triiron disulphide trioxide

Name: nickel incorporation into iron-sulfur cluster via tris-L-cysteinyl L-cysteine persulfido L-glutamato L-histidino L-serinyl nickel triiron disulfide trioxide
Definition: The incorporation of nickel into a 3Fe-2S complex by tris-L-cysteinyl L-cysteine persulfido L-glutamato L-histidino L-serinyl nickel triiron disulfide trioxide.
Synonyms: nickel incorporation into iron-sulphur cluster via tris-L-cysteinyl L-cysteine persulphido L-glutamato L-histidino L-serinyl nickel triiron disulphide trioxide

Name: protein catenane formation
Definition: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a protein structure comprising two or more rings that are interlocked but not covalently joined; resembling the links of a chain.

Name: obsolete peptide cross-linking via N6-(L-isoaspartyl)-L-lysine
Definition: OBSOLETE. The formation of isopeptide bonds by ligation of peptidyl-lysine and peptidyl-asparagine residues.

Name: UDP-N-acetylglucosamine:serine-protein N-acetylglucosamine-1-phosphotransferase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the transfer of N-acetylglucosamine-1-phosphate to a serine residue in a protein.

Name: GDP-mannose:serine-protein mannose-1-phosphotransferase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the transfer of mannose-1-phosphate to a serine residue in a protein.

Name: protein C-terminal leucine carboxyl O-methyltransferase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + [protein]-L-leucine = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + [protein]-L-leucine methyl ester. This modification occurs only at the oxygen atoms of the free alpha carboxyl group of a leucine residue at the C-terminus of the protein.

Name: obsolete peptidyl-glutamic acid poly-ADP-ribosylation
Definition: OBSOLETE. This modification produces peptidyl-glutamic acid poly-ADP-ribose found in a number of nuclear proteins under certain conditions including the repair of single strand DNA breaks. The activated form of the generating enzyme poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase is itself modified in this way.

Name: O3-(N-acetylglucosamine-1-phosphoryl)-L-serine biosynthetic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of O3-(N-acetylglucosamine-1-phosphoryl)-L-serine. The recovery of O-phosphorylserine from acid hydrolysates suggests N-acetylglucosamine-1-phosphate residues are esterified to peptidyl serines through phosphoester bonds.

Name: O3-(phosphoglycosyl-D-mannose-1-phosphoryl)-L-serine biosynthetic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of O3-(phosphoglycosyl-D-mannose-1-phosphoryl)-L-serine. The polypeptide backbones of glycoproteins and mucin-like proteoglycans are extensively modified with a complex array of phosphoglycan chains that are linked to Ser/Thr-rich domains via a common Man-alpha1-phosphate-Ser linkage.

Name: copper incorporation into metallo-sulfur cluster
Definition: The incorporation of copper into a metallo-sulfur cluster.

Name: copper incorporation into copper-sulfur cluster
Definition: The incorporation of copper into a copper-sulfur cluster.

Name: copper incorporation into copper-sulfur cluster via heptakis-L-histidino tetracopper mu4-sulfide hydroxide
Definition: The incorporation of copper into a 4Cu-S copper-sulfur cluster via heptakis-L-histidino tetracopper mu4-sulfide hydroxide.
Synonyms: copper incorporation into copper-sulphur cluster via heptakis-L-histidino tetracopper mu4-sulphide hydroxide

Name: obsolete peptidyl-L-leucine methyl ester biosynthetic process from peptidyl-leucine
Definition: OBSOLETE. The modification of a C-terminal peptidyl-leucine to form peptidyl-L-leucine methyl ester.

Name: iron incorporation into iron-sulfur cluster via hexakis-L-cysteinyl L-serinyl octairon heptasulfide
Definition: The incorporation of iron into a 8Fe-7S iron-sulfur cluster via hexakis-L-cysteinyl L-serinyl octairon heptasulfide, found in nitrogenase.
Synonyms: iron incorporation into iron-sulphur cluster via hexakis-L-cysteinyl L-serinyl octairon heptasulphide

Name: obsolete peptidyl-glutamic acid esterification
Definition: OBSOLETE. The addition of an ester group to a glutamic acid residue in a protein.

Name: obsolete enzyme active site formation via L-aspartic 4-phosphoric anhydride
Definition: OBSOLETE. The transient phosphorylation of peptidyl-aspartic acid to form L-aspartic 4-phosphoric anhydride.

Name: translation release factor complex
Definition: A heterodimeric complex involved in the release of a nascent polypeptide chain from a ribosome.

Name: prothoracicotrophic hormone activity
Definition: The action characteristic of prothoracicotrophic hormone, a peptide hormone that is secreted by the brain and, upon receptor binding, acts on the prothoracic gland to stimulate the release of ecdysone in insects.

Name: pinocarveol dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: pinocarveol = pinocarvone + 2 H+ + 2 e-.

Name: chloral hydrate dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reactions: chloral hydrate = 3 H+ + 2 e- + trichloroacetate, and chloral hydrate + H2 = H2O + trichloroethanol.

Name: hydroxymethylmethylsilanediol oxidase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: hydroxymethylmethylsilanediol + O2 + 2 H+ + 2 e- = formylmethylsilanediol + 2 H2O.

Name: 1-phenylethanol dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-1-phenylethanol + NAD+ = acetophenone + H+ + NADH.

Name: myrtenol dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: myrtenol + O2 + 2 H+ + 2 e- = 2 H2O + myrtenal.

Name: epoxide dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ethene oxide + NAD+ + CoA-SH = NADH + H+ + acetyl-CoA.

Name: 5-exo-hydroxycamphor dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-exo-hydroxycamphor + NAD+ = NADH + H+ + 2,5-diketocamphane.

Name: 2-hydroxytetrahydrofuran dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-hydroxytetrahydrofuran = 2 H+ + 2 e- + butyrolactone.

Name: acetoacetyl-CoA reductase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA + NADP+ = 3-oxoacyl-CoA + NADPH + H+.

Name: alcohol dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an alcohol + NAD(P)+ = an aldehyde + NAD(P)H + H+.

Name: aryl-alcohol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an aromatic alcohol + NAD+ = an aromatic aldehyde + NADH + H+.

Name: perillyl-alcohol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD+ + perillyl alcohol = H+ + NADH + perillyl aldehyde.

Name: isopiperitenol dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (1S,6R)-isopiperitenol + NAD+ = (6R)-isoperitenone + H+ + NADH.

Name: carveol dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (1S,5R)-carveol + NADP+ = (R)-carvone + H+ + NADPH.

Name: cyclohexanol dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cyclohexanol + NAD+ = cyclohexanone + NADH + H+.

Name: fluoren-9-ol dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: fluoren-9-ol + 2 NADP+ = fluoren-9-one + 2 NADPH + 2 H+.

Name: 4-(hydroxymethyl)benzenesulfonate dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-(hydroxymethyl)benzenesulfonate + NAD+ = 4-formylbenzenesulfonate + H+ + NADH.

Name: 6-hydroxyhexanoate dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-hydroxyhexanoate + NAD+ = 6-oxohexanoate + H+ + NADH.

Name: 3-hydroxypimeloyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-hydroxypimelyl-CoA + NAD+ = 3-oxopimelyl-CoA + H+ + NADH.

Name: vanillyl-alcohol oxidase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O2 + vanillyl alcohol = H2O2 + vanillin.

Name: limonene-1,2-diol dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (1S,2S,4R)-limonene-1,2-diol + DCPIP+ = DCPIPH + H+ + (1S,4R)-1-hydroxy-2-oxolimonene.

Name: formaldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: formaldehyde + H2O + NAD+ = formate + 2 H+ + NADH.

Name: myrtenal dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: myrtenal + H2O = 2 H+ + 2 e- + myrtenic acid.

Name: 4-hydroxybutaraldehyde dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxybutyraldehyde + H2O = 2 H+ + 2 e- + 4-hydroxybutanoate.

Name: 4-chlorobenzaldehyde oxidase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-chlorobenzaldehyde + 2 H2O = 4-chlorobenzoate + 2 H+ + 2 e-.

Name: 1-hydroxy-2-naphthaldehyde dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-hydroxy-2-naphthaldehyde + NAD+ + H2O = NADH + H+ + 1-hydroxy-2-naphthoate.

Name: cis-2-methyl-5-isopropylhexa-2,5-dienal dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cis-2-methyl-5-isopropylhexa-2,5-dienal + NAD+ + H2O = NADH + H+ + cis-2-methyl-5-isopropylhexa-2,5-dienoic acid.

Name: 2-formylbenzoate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-formylbenzoate + H2O + NAD+ = 2 H+ + NADH + phthalate.

Name: trans-2-methyl-5-isopropylhexa-2,5-dienal dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans-2-methyl-5-isopropylhexa-2,5-dienal + NAD+ + H2O = NADH + H+ + trans-2-methyl-5-isopropylhexa-2,5-dienoic acid.

Name: benzaldehyde dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: benzaldehyde + NADP+ + H2O = benzoate + NADPH + H+.

Name: malonate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase (acetylating) activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-oxopropanoate + CoA + NAD(P)+ = acetyl-CoA + CO2 + NAD(P)H.

Name: benzaldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: benzaldehyde + NAD+ + H2O = benzoate + NADH + H+.

Name: 5-carboxymethyl-2-hydroxymuconic-semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-carboxymethyl-2-hydroxymuconate semialdehyde + H2O + NAD+ = 5-carboxymethyl-2-hydroxymuconate + NADH + H+.

Name: 4-hydroxymuconic-semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: <stereo>cis,trans</stereo>-4-hydroxymuconate semialdehyde + H2O + NAD+ = 2 H+ + maleylacetate + NADH.

Name: 4-formylbenzenesulfonate dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-formylbenzenesulfonate + H2O + NAD+ = 4-sulfobenzoate + 2 H+ + NADH.

Name: 6-oxohexanoate dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-oxohexanoate + NADP+ + H2O = adipate + NADPH + H+.

Name: 4-hydroxybenzaldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxybenzaldehyde + NAD+ + H2O = 4-hydroxybenzoate + NADH + H+.

Name: salicylaldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: salicylaldehyde + NAD+ + H2O = salicylate + NADH + H+.

Name: 2-butanone oxidase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: methyl ethyl ketone + O2 = H2O + ethyl acetate.

Name: vanillate O-demethylase (anaerobic) activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: vanillate + Co+ = Co3+-CH3 + 3,4-dihydroxybenzoate.

Name: aryl-aldehyde oxidase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an aromatic aldehyde + O2 + H2O = an aromatic acid + hydrogen peroxide.

Name: vanillate monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + NADH + O2 + vanillate = 3,4-dihydroxybenzoate + formaldehyde + H2O + NAD+.

Name: 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate oxidase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)pyruvate + O2 = 2 4-hydroxyphenylacetate + 2 CO2.

Name: 2-oxobutyrate synthase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxobutanoate + CoA + oxidized ferredoxin = propanoyl-CoA + CO2 + reduced ferredoxin.

Name: obsolete carbon-monoxide dehydrogenase (acceptor) activity
Definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: CO + H2O + acceptor = CO2 + reduced acceptor.

Name: formylmethanofuran dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-formylmethanofuran + A + H2O + H+ = AH(2) + CO2 + methanofuran.

Name: carvone reductase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: carvone + 2 H+ + 2 e- = dihydrocarvone.

Name: 2-hydroxycyclohexane-1-carboxyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-hydroxycyclohexane-1-carboxyl-CoA = 2 H+ + 2 e- + 2-ketocyclohexane-1-carboxyl-CoA.

Name: 2,6-dihydroxycyclohexane-1-carboxyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,6-dihydroxycyclohexane-1-carboxyl-CoA = 2 H+ + 2 e- + 6-oxo-2-hydroxycyclohexane-1-carboxyl-CoA.

Name: 1-chloro-2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethane dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-chloro-2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethene + 2 H+ + 2 e- = 1-chloro-2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethane. 1-chloro-2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethene is also known as DDMU; 1-chloro-2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethane is also known as DDMS.

Name: 2,3-dihydroxy-2,3-dihydro-phenylpropionate dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-(cis-5,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-1,3-dien-1-yl)propanoate + NAD+ = 3-(2,3-dihydroxyphenyl)propanoate + H+ + NADH. Also converts (2E)-3-(cis-5,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-1,3-dien-1-yl)prop-2-enoate to (2E)-3-(2,3-dihydroxyphenyl)prop-2-enoate.

Name: cis-2,3-dihydrodiol DDT dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cis-2,3-dihydrodiol DDT + NADP+ = NADPH + 2,3-dihydroxy DDT.

Name: trans-9R,10R-dihydrodiolphenanthrene dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans-9R,10R-dihydrodiolphenanthrene + NAD+ = NADH + H+ + 9,10-dihydroxyphenanthrene.

Name: cis-chlorobenzene dihydrodiol dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the conversion of a di- or tetrachlorinated dienol to the corresponding catechol.

Name: 2,5-dichloro-2,5-cyclohexadiene-1,4-diol dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,5-dichloro-2,5-cyclohexadiene-1,4-diol + NAD+ = NADH + H+ + 2,5-dichlorohydroquinone.

Name: trans-1,2-dihydrodiolphenanthrene dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans-1,2-dihydrodiolphenanthrene + NAD+ = H+ + NADH + 1,2-dihydroxyphenanthrene.

Name: cis-1,2-dihydrobenzene-1,2-diol dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cis-1,2-dihydrobenzene-1,2-diol + NAD+ = catechol + NADH + H+.

Name: cis-1,2-dihydro-1,2-dihydroxynaphthalene dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cis-1,2-dihydronaphthalene-1,2-diol + NAD+ = naphthalene-1,2-diol + NADH + H+.

Name: maleylacetate reductase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-oxoadipate + NAD(P)+ = 2-maleylacetate + NAD(P)H + H+.

Name: cis-3,4-dihydrophenanthrene-3,4-diol dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (3S,4R)-3,4-dihydrophenanthrene-3,4-diol + NAD+ = H+ + NADH + phenanthrene-3,4-diol.

Name: obsolete cis-1,2-dihydroxycyclohexa-3,5-diene-1-carboxylate dehydrogenase activity
Definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: cis-1,2-dihydroxycyclohexa-3,5-diene-1-carboxylate + NAD+ = catechol + CO2 + NADH + H+.

Name: cis-2,3-dihydrobiphenyl-2,3-diol dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cis-3-phenylcyclohexa-3,5-diene-1,2-diol + NAD+ = biphenyl-2,3-diol + NADH + H+.

Name: phloroglucinol reductase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dihydrophloroglucinol + NADP+ = H+ + NADPH + phloroglucinol.

Name: 2,3-dihydroxy-2,3-dihydro-p-cumate dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cis-2,3-dihydroxy-2,3-dihydro-p-cumate + NAD+ = 2,3-dihydroxy-p-cumate + H+ + NADH.

Name: obsolete 1,6-dihydroxy-5-methylcyclohexa-2,4-dienecarboxylate dehydrogenase activity
Definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: 1,6-dihydroxy-5-methylcyclohexa-2,4-dienecarboxylate + NAD+ = 3-methylcatechol + CO2 + NADH + H+.

Name: dibenzothiophene dihydrodiol dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cis-1,2-dihydroxy-1,2-dihydrodibenzothiophene + NAD+ = 1,2-dihydroxydibenzothiophene + H+ + NADH.

Name: pimeloyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD+ + pimelyl-CoA = 2,3-didehydropimeloyl-CoA + H+ + NADH.

Name: 2,4-dichlorobenzoyl-CoA reductase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-chlorobenzoyl-CoA + chloride + NADP+ = 2,4-dichlorobenzoyl-CoA + NADPH.

Name: phthalate 4,5-cis-dihydrodiol dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cis-4,5-dihydroxycyclohexa-2,6-diene-1,2-dicarboxylate + NAD+ = 4,5-dihydroxyphthalate + H+ + NADH.

Name: 5,6-dihydroxy-3-methyl-2-oxo-1,2,5,6-tetrahydroquinoline dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5,6-dihydroxy-3-methyl-5,6-dihydroquinolin-2(1H)-one + NAD+ = 5,6-dihydroxy-3-methyl-2-oxo-1,2-dihydroquinoline + H+ + NADH.

Name: cis-dihydroethylcatechol dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cis-1,2-dihydro-3-ethylcatechol + NAD+ = 3-ethylcatechol + H+ + NADH.

Name: cis-1,2-dihydroxy-4-methylcyclohexa-3,5-diene-1-carboxylate dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cis-1,2-dihydroxy-4-methylcyclohexa-3,5-diene-1-carboxylate + NADP+ = 4-methylcatechol + NADPH + H+ + CO2.

Name: 1,2-dihydroxy-6-methylcyclohexa-3,5-dienecarboxylate dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,6-dihydroxy-2-methylcyclohexa-2,4-dienecarboxylate + NAD+ = 3-methylcatechol + CO2 + NADH.

Name: benzoyl-CoA reductase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 ADP + cyclohexa-1,5-diene-1-carbonyl-CoA + oxidized ferredoxin + 2 phosphate = 2 ATP + 2 H2O + benzoyl-CoA + reduced ferredoxin.

Name: quinoline 2-oxidoreductase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: quinoline + acceptor + H2O = isoquinolin-1(2H)-one + reduced acceptor.

Name: acetophenone carboxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetophenone + CO2 = H+ + benzoyl acetate.

Name: 4-hydroxybenzoyl-CoA reductase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: benzoyl-CoA + oxidized ferredoxin + H2O = 4-hydroxybenzoyl-CoA + reduced ferredoxin.

Name: 2-aminobenzoyl-CoA reductase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-aminobenzoyl-CoA + 2 H+ + 2 e- = NH3 + benzoyl-CoA.

Name: cyclohexylamine oxidase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cyclohexylamine + O2 + H2O = cyclohexanone + NH3 + hydrogen peroxide.

Name: iminodiacetate dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: iminodiacetate + OH- = H+ + 2 e- + glyoxylate + glycine.

Name: nitrilotriacetate monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nitrilotriacetate + FMNH2 + O2 = aminodiacetate + FMN + glyoxylate + H2O.

Name: (R)-6-hydroxynicotine oxidase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-6-hydroxynicotine + H2O + O2 = 6-hydroxypseudooxynicotine + H2O2.

Name: (S)-6-hydroxynicotine oxidase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-6-hydroxynicotine + H2O + O2 = 6-hydroxypseudooxynicotine + H2O2.

Name: 5,10-methenyl-5,6,7,8-tetrahydromethanopterin dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N5,N10-methenyltetrahydromethanopterin + H2 = N5,N10-methylenetetrahydromethanopterin.

Name: peptidyl-cysteine acetylation
Definition: The acetylation of peptidyl-cysteine.

Name: nitrilotriacetate dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nitrilotriacetate + OH- = H+ + 2 e- + glyoxylate + iminodiacetate.

Name: nicotine dehydrogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nicotine + acceptor + H2O = (S)-6-hydroxynicotine + reduced acceptor.

Name: coenzyme F420-dependent N5,N10-methenyltetrahydromethanopterin reductase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-methyltetrahydromethanopterin + coenzyme F420 + H+ = 5,10-methylenetetrahydromethanopterin + reduced coenzyme F420.

Name: epoxide carboxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the generic reaction: epoxide + CO2 + NAD+ + electron donor = beta-keto acid + NADH + reduced electron donor; the electron donor may be NADPH or a dithiol. This reaction is the ring opening and carboxylation of an epoxide; for example: epoxypropane + CO2 + NAD+ + NADPH = acetoacetate + NADH + NADP+.

Name: p-benzoquinone reductase (NADPH) activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,4-benzoquinone + H+ + NADPH = hydroquinone + NADP+.

Name: 2,3-dihydroxy DDT 1,2-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,3-dihydroxy DDT + O2 = 6-oxo-2-hydroxy-7-(4-chlorophenyl)-3,8,8,8-tetrachloroocta-2E,4E-dienoate.

Name: obsolete 4-amino-2-nitroso-6-nitrotoluene reductase activity
Definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: 4-amino-2-hydroxylamino-6-nitrotoluene + NADP+ = NADPH + H+ + 4-amino-2-nitroso-6-nitrotoluene.

Name: obsolete 4-carboxy-4'-sulfoazobenzene reductase activity
Definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: 4-carboxy-4'-sulfoazobenzene + 4 H+ + 4 e- = 4-aminobenzoate + 4-aminobenzenesulfonate.

Name: obsolete NAD(P)H nitroreductase activity
Definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the conversion of a nitrate group to an amino or hydroxylamino group on toluene or a toluene derivative.

Name: nitrobenzene nitroreductase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nitrobenzene + 2 NADPH + 2 H+ = hydroxyaminobenzene + 2 NADP+ + H2O.

Name: nitroglycerin reductase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the removal of one or more nitrite (NO2-) groups from nitroglycerin or a derivative.

Name: pentaerythritol trinitrate reductase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: pentaerythritol trinitrate + NADPH = NADP+ + nitrate + pentaerythritol dinitrate.

Name: methanethiol oxidase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: methanethiol + O2 + H2O = formaldehyde + hydrogen sulfide + hydrogen peroxide.

Name: tetrachloro-p-hydroquinone reductive dehalogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,3,5,6-tetrachlorohydroquinone + 2 glutathione = 2,3,6-trichlorohydroquinone + glutathione disulfide + HCl.

Name: dissimilatory sulfite reductase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reactions: [DsrC protein]-trisulfide + 3 H2O + NAD+ = [DsrC protein]-dithiol + 3 H+ + NADH + sulfite.

Name: 3-(2,3-dihydroxyphenyl)propionate 1,2-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-(2,3-dihydroxyphenyl)propionate + O2 = 2-hydroxy-6-keto-nona-2,4-dienedioate.

Name: 1,2-dihydroxynaphthalene dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,2-dihydroxynaphthalene + O2 = 2-hydroxychromene-2-carboxylate. C6 of the substrate molecular may have an NH2 group attached.

Name: phenanthrene dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phenanthrene + NADH + H+ + O2 = NAD+ + cis-3,4-dihydroxy-3,4-dihydrophenanthrene.

Name: 2,2',3-trihydroxybiphenyl dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,3-dihydroxybenzenoid + O2 = H+ + distal extradiol ring cleavage. Substrates are 2,2',3-trihydroxybiphenyl (forms 2-hydroxy-6-oxo-6-(2-hydroxyphenyl)-hexa-2,4-dienoate) and 2,2',3-trihydroxydiphenylether (forms 2,3-hydroxy-6-oxo-6-(2-hydroxyphenyl)-hexa-2,4-dienoate).

Name: 1,2-dihydroxyfluorene 1,1-alpha-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,2-dihydroxyfluorene + O2 = 2-hydroxy-4-(2-oxo-1,3-dihydro-2H-inden-1-ylidene) but-2-enoic acid.

Name: 5,6-dihydroxy-3-methyl-2-oxo-1,2-dihydroquinoline dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5,6-dihydroxy-3-methyl-2-oxo-1,2-dihydroquinoline + O2 = 3-methyl-5-hydroxy-6-(3-carboxy-3-oxopropenyl)-1H-2-pyridon.

Name: 1,1-dichloro-2-(dihydroxy-4-chlorophenyl)-(4-chlorophenyl)ethene 1,2-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,1-dichloro-2-(dihydroxy-4'-chorophenyl)-2-(4-chlorophenyl)ethene + O2 = 6-oxo-2-hydroxy-7-(4-chlorophenyl)-3,8,8-trichloroocta-2E,4E,7-trienoate.

Name: protocatechuate 3,4-dioxygenase type II activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-sulfocatechol + O2 = 3-sulfomuconate.

Name: 2'-aminobiphenyl-2,3-diol 1,2-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2'-aminobiphenyl-2,3-diol + O2 = H+ + 2-hydroxy-6-oxo-(2'-aminophenyl)-hexa-2,4-dienoate.

Name: 3,4-dihydroxyfluorene 4,4-alpha-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3,4-dihydroxyfluorene + O2 = 2-hydroxy-4-(1-oxo-1,3-dihydro-2H-inden-2-ylidene) but-2-enoic acid.

Name: 2,3-dihydroxy-ethylbenzene 1,2-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,3-dihydroxyethylbenzene + O2 = H+ + 2-hydroxy-6-oxoocta-2,4-dienoate.

Name: carbazole 1,9a-dioxygenase [NAD(P)H] activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 9H-carbazole + H+ + NAD(P)H + O2 = 2'-aminobiphenyl-2,3-diol + NAD(P)+.

Name: dihydroxydibenzothiophene dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,2-dihydroxydibenzothiophene + O2 = cis-4-(2-(3-hydroxy)-thionaphthenyl)-2-oxo-3-butenoate.

Name: 1,2-dihydroxynaphthalene-6-sulfonate 1,8a-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,2-dihydroxynaphthalene-6-sulfonate + O2 = H+ + (Z)-4-(2-hydroxy-5-sulfonatophenyl)-2-oxo-3-butenoate.

Name: styrene dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: styrene + O2 + NADH + H+ = NAD+ + styrene cis-glycol.

Name: 3,4-dihydroxyphenanthrene dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3,4-dihydroxyphenanthrene + O2 = H+ + 2-hydroxy-2 H-benzo[h]chromene-2-carboxylate.

Name: hydroquinone 1,2-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: hydroquinone + O2 = cis,trans-4-hydroxymuconic semialdehyde.

Name: p-cumate 2,3-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: p-cumate + NADH + H+ + O2 = NAD+ + cis-2,3-dihydroxy-2,3-dihydro-p-cumate.

Name: 2,3-dihydroxy-p-cumate dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,3-dihydroxy-p-cumate + O2 = 2-hydroxy-3-carboxy-6-oxo-7-methylocta-2,4-dienoate.

Name: 3,5-dichlorocatechol 1,2-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3,5-dichlorocatechol + O2 = 2 H+ + 2,4-dichloro-cis,cis-muconate.

Name: 2-aminophenol 1,6-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-aminophenol + O2 = 2-aminomuconic semialdehyde.

Name: 2,6-dichloro-p-hydroquinone 1,2-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,6-dichlorohydroquinone + O2 + H2O = HCl + 2 H+ + 2-chloromaleylacetate.

Name: chlorocatechol 1,2-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3,6-dichlorocatechol + O2 = 2 H+ + 2,5-dichloro-cis,cis-muconate.

Name: catechol 1,2-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: catechol + O2 = cis,cis-muconate.

Name: catechol 2,3-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: catechol + O2 = 2-hydroxymuconate semialdehyde.

Name: protocatechuate 3,4-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3,4-dihydroxybenzoate + O2 = 3-carboxy-cis,cis-muconate.

Name: protocatechuate 4,5-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protocatechuate + O2 = 4-carboxy-2-hydroxymuconate semialdehyde.

Name: nitronate monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ethylnitronate + O2 = acetaldehyde + nitrite.

Name: hydroxyquinol 1,2-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: benzene-1,2,4-triol + O2 = 3-hydroxy-cis,cis-muconate + 2 H+.

Name: 1-hydroxy-2-naphthoate 1,2-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-hydroxy-2-naphthoate + O2 = (3E)-4-(2-carboxyphenyl)-2-oxobut-3-enoate.

Name: biphenyl-2,3-diol 1,2-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: biphenyl-2,3-diol + O2 = 2-hydroxy-6-oxo-6-phenylhexa-2,4-dienoate + H2O.

Name: 2,4,5-trichlorophenoxyacetic acid oxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,4,5-trichlorophenoxyacetic acid + 1/2 O2 = glyoxylate + 2,4,5-trichlorophenol.

Name: fluorene oxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: fluorene + 2 H+ + 2 e- + O2 = H2O + 9-fluorenol.

Name: mono-butyltin dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: butyltin + O2 + 2 H+ + 2 e- = H2O + beta-hydroxybutyltin.

Name: obsolete limonene 8-monooxygenase activity
Definition: OBSOLETE. (Was not defined before being made obsolete).

Name: tri-n-butyltin dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: tri-n-butyltin + O2 + 2 H+ + 2 e- = H2O + beta-hydroxybutyldibutyltin.

Name: di-n-butyltin dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dibutyltin + O2 + 2 H+ + 2 e- = H2O + beta-hydroxybutylbutyltin.

Name: methylsilanetriol hydroxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: methylsilanetriol + O2 + 2 H+ + 2 e- = H2O + hydroxymethylsilanetriol.

Name: methyl tertiary butyl ether 3-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: methyl tert-butyl ether + 1/2 O2 = tert-butyl alcohol + formaldehyde.

Name: 4-nitrocatechol 4-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-nitrocatechol + O2 + 4 e- + 3 H+ = H2O + nitrite + 1,2,4-benzenetriol.

Name: 4-chlorophenoxyacetate monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-chlorophenoxyacetate + 1/2 O2 = glyoxylate + 4-chlorophenol.

Name: tert-butanol 2-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: tert-butanol + 1/2 O2 = 2-methyl-2-hydroxy-1-propanol.

Name: obsolete alpha-pinene monooxygenase activity
Definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-pinene + O2 + 2 H+ + 2 e- = H2O + pinocarveol.

Name: dimethylsilanediol hydroxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dimethylsilanediol + O2 + 2 H+ + 2 e- = H2O + hydroxymethylmethylsilanediol.

Name: ammonia monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: AH2 + NH4+ + O2 = A + H+ + H2O + hydroxylamine.

Name: hydroxymethylsilanetriol oxidase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: hydroxymethylsilanetriol + O2 + 2 H+ + 2 e- = 2 H2O + formylsilanetriol.

Name: 2-hydroxyisobutyrate 3-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-hydroxyisobutyrate + 1/2 O2 = 2,3-dihydroxy-2-methyl propionate.

Name: obsolete alpha-pinene dehydrogenase activity
Definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-pinene + O2 + 2 H+ + 2 e- = H2O + myrtenol.

Name: 4-nitrophenol 2-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-nitrophenol + H+ + NADH + O2 = 4-nitrocatechol + H2O + NAD+.

Name: 2,4-dichlorophenoxyacetate alpha-ketoglutarate dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,4-dichlorophenoxyacetate + 2-oxoglutarate + oxygen = 2,4-dichlorophenol + glyoxylate + succinate + CO2.

Name: nitrobenzene 1,2-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nitrobenzene + NADH + O2 = NAD+ + nitrite + catechol.

Name: 4-aminobenzoate 3,4-dioxygenase (deaminating) activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-aminobenzoate + 2 H+ + O2 + 2 e- = NH3 + 3,4-dihydroxybenzoate.

Name: benzenesulfonate dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: toluene-4-sulfonate + NADH + O2 + H+ = NAD+ + HSO3(-) + 4-methylcatechol.

Name: 1-indanone monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-indanone + NADPH + 1/2 O2 = NADP+ + 3,4-dihydrocoumarin.

Name: 1-indanone dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-indanone + NADPH + 1/2 O2 = NADP+ + 3-hydroxy-1-indanone.

Name: chlorobenzene dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,3-unsubstituted benzenoid + O2 + NAD(P)H + H+ = 2,3-cis-dihydroxydihydrobenzenoid + NAD(P)+. Substrates include 1,4-dichlorobenzene (forms 3,6-dichloro-cis-1,2-dihydroxycyclohexa-3,5-diene), 1,2,3,4-tetrachlorobenzene (forms cis-chlorobenzene dihydrodiol) and 1,2,4-trichlorobenzene (forms 3,4,6-trichloro-cis-1,2-dihydroxycyclohexa-3,5-diene).

Name: dibenzofuran 4,4a-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dibenzofuran + NADH + H+ + O2 = 2,2',3-trihydroxybiphenyl + NAD+.

Name: toluate dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: methylbenzoate + NADH + O2 + H+ = NAD+ + 1,2-dihydroxymethylcyclohexa-3,5-dienecarboxylate.

Name: dibenzothiophene dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dibenzothiophene + NADH + O2 + H+ = NAD+ + cis-1,2-dihydroxy-1,2-dihydrodibenzothiophene.

Name: 9-fluorenone dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 9-fluorenone + 2 NADPH + O2 = 2 NADP+ + 3,4-dihydroxy-3,4-dihydro-9-fluorenone.

Name: ethylbenzene dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ethylbenzene + O2 + NADH + H+ = NAD+ + cis-2,3-dihydroxy-2,3-dihydroethylbenzene.

Name: 2-indanone monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-indanone + NADPH + 1/2 O2 = NADP+ + 3-isochromanone.

Name: trihydroxytoluene dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,3,5-trihydroxytoluene + O2 = 2,4,6-trioxoheptanoate.

Name: 4-aminobenzenesulfonate 3,4-dioxygenase (deaminating) activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-aminobenzenesulfonate + 2 H+ + O2 + 2 e- = NH3 + 4-sulfocatechol.

Name: anthranilate 1,2-dioxygenase (deaminating, decarboxylating) activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: anthranilate + NADPH + H+ + O2 = catechol + CO2 + NADP+ + NH3.

Name: benzene 1,2-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: benzene + H+ + NADH + O2 = cis-cyclohexa-3,5-diene-1,2-diol + NAD+.

Name: phthalate 4,5-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + NADH + O2 + phthalate = cis-4,5-dihydroxycyclohexa-2,6-diene-1,2-dicarboxylate + NAD+.

Name: 4-sulfobenzoate 3,4-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-sulfobenzoate + H+ + NADH + O2 = 3,4-dihydroxybenzoate + NAD+ + sulfite.

Name: 4-chlorophenylacetate 3,4-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-chlorophenylacetate + NADH + O2 = 3,4-dihydroxyphenylacetate + chloride + NAD+.

Name: benzoate 1,2-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: benzoate + NADH + H+ + O2 = catechol + CO2 + NAD+.

Name: toluene dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + NADH + O2 + toluene = (1S,2R)-3-methylcyclohexa-3,5-diene-1,2-diol + NAD+.

Name: naphthalene 1,2-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: naphthalene + NADH + H+ + O2 = (1R,2S)-1,2-dihydronaphthalene-1,2-diol + NAD+.

Name: 2-chlorobenzoate 1,2-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-chlorobenzoate + NADH + H+ + O2 = catechol + chloride + NAD+ + CO2.

Name: 2-aminobenzenesulfonate 2,3-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-aminobenzenesulfonate + 2 H+ + NADH + O2 = 2,3-dihydroxybenzenesulfonate + NAD+ + NH4. 2,3-dihydroxybenzenesulfonate is also known as 3-sulfocatechol.

Name: terephthalate 1,2-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + NADH + O2 + terephthalate = (3S,4R)-3,4-dihydroxycyclohexa-1,5-diene-1,4-dicarboxylate + NAD+.

Name: 2-hydroxyquinoline 5,6-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: quinolin-2-ol + NADH + H+ + O2 = 2,5,6-trihydroxy-5,6-dihydroquinoline + NAD+.

Name: 3,5-xylenol methylhydroxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-hydroxytoluene + NADH + O2 = NAD+ + OH- + 3-hydroxybenzyl alcohol.

Name: phenylacetate 2-hydroxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-phenylacetate + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = (2-hydroxyphenyl)acetate + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase].

Name: 4-nitrophenol 4-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: p-nitrophenol + O2 + NADPH = H2O + NADP+ + nitrite + p-benzoquinone.

Name: dimethyl sulfide monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dimethyl sulfide + H+ + NADH + O2 = formaldehyde + H2O + methanethiol + NAD+.

Name: alpha-pinene monooxygenase (NADH) activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-pinene + NADH + H+ + O2 = NAD+ + H2O + alpha-pinene oxide.

Name: obsolete (R)-limonene 1,2-monooxygenase activity
Definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: (4R)-limonene + NAD(P)H + H+ + O2 = NAD(P)+ + H2O + (4R)-limonene-1,2-epoxide.

Name: phenanthrene 9,10-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phenanthrene + O2 + NADH + H+ = H2O + NAD+ + phenanthrene-9,10-oxide.

Name: 1-hydroxy-2-naphthoate hydroxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-hydroxy-2-naphthoate + O2 + NAD(P)H + 2 H+ = NAD(P)+ + H2O + CO2 + 1,2-dihydroxynaphthalene.

Name: toluene 4-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: toluene + H+ + NADH + O2 = 4-methylphenol + H2O + NAD+.

Name: xylene monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reactions: toluene + 1/2 O2 = benzyl alcohol, and xylene + 1/2 O2 = methylbenzyl alcohol.

Name: dibenzothiophene monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dibenzothiophene + NADH + H+ + O2 = dibenzothiophene-5-oxide + NAD+ + H2O.

Name: 6-hydroxy-3-methyl-2-oxo-1,2-dihydroquinoline 6-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-hydroxy-3-methyl-2-oxo-1,2-dihydroquinoline + O2 + 2 H+ + 2 e- = H2O + 5,6-dihydroxy-3-methyl-2-oxo-1,2-dihydroquinoline.

Name: chlorophenol 4-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the addition or substitution of an OH group on C4 of a halogenated phenol.

Name: carbon disulfide oxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: carbon disulfide + NADH + H+ + O2 = [S] + H2O + NAD+ + carbonyl sulfide.

Name: toluene 2-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: toluene + H+ + NADH + O2 = 2-hydroxytoluene + H2O + NAD+.

Name: alkene monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: propene + NADH + H+ + O2 = 1,2-epoxypropane + NAD+ + H2O.

Name: 1-hydroxy-2-oxolimonene 1,2-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (1S,4R)-1-hydroxy-2-oxolimonene + NADPH + O2 = NADP+ + OH- + (3R)-3-isopropenyl-6-oxoheptanoate.

Name: phenanthrene 1,2-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phenanthrene + O2 + NADH + H+ = H2O + NAD+ + phenanthrene-1,2-oxide.

Name: methanesulfonate monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: methanesulfonate + NADH + H+ + O2 = formaldehyde + NAD+ + sulfite + H2O.

Name: tetrahydrofuran hydroxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: tetrahydrofuran + O2 + 2 H+ + 2 e- = H2O + 2-hydroxytetrahydrofuran.

Name: styrene monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: styrene + NADPH + FADH + O2 = NADP+ + FAD+ + H2O + styrene oxide.

Name: toluene-4-sulfonate monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: toluene-4-sulfonate + 1/2 O2 + H+ = HSO3(-) + 4-hydroxytoluene.

Name: toluene-sulfonate methyl-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: toluene-4-sulfonate + NADH + O2 = NAD+ + OH- + 4-sulfobenzyl alcohol.

Name: 3-methyl-2-oxo-1,2-dihydroquinoline 6-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-methyl-2-oxo-1,2-dihydroquinoline + O2 + 2 H+ + 2 e- = H2O + 6-hydroxy-3-methyl-2-oxo-1,2-dihydroquinoline.

Name: 2-hydroxy-phenylacetate hydroxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-hydroxyphenylacetate + NADH + O2 = NAD+ + OH- + homogentisate.

Name: 2-oxo-delta3-4,5,5-trimethylcyclopentenylacetyl-CoA 1,2-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxo-delta3-4,5,5-trimethylcyclopentenylacetyl-CoA + NADH + H+ + O2 = NAD+ + H2O + delta2,5-3,4,4-trimethylpimelyl-CoA.

Name: phenanthrene 3,4-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phenanthrene + O2 + NADH + H+ = H2O + NAD+ + phenanthrene-3,4-oxide.

Name: obsolete toluene 3-monooxygenase activity
Definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: toluene + 1/2 O2 = 3-hydroxytoluene.

Name: salicylate 1-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: salicylate + NADH + H+ + O2 = catechol + NAD+ + H2O + CO2.

Name: 4-hydroxybenzoate 3-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxybenzoate + NADPH + H+ + O2 = protocatechuate + NADP+ + H2O.

Name: obsolete 4-hydroxyphenylacetate,NADH:oxygen oxidoreductase (3-hydroxylating) activity
Definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxyphenylacetate + NADH + H+ + O2 = 3,4-dihydroxyphenylacetate + NAD+ + H2O.

Name: orcinol 2-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + NADH + O2 + orcinol = 2,3,5-trihydroxytoluene + H2O + NAD+.

Name: phenol 2-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phenol + NADPH + H+ + O2 = catechol + NADP+ + H2O.

Name: 2,6-dihydroxypyridine 3-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,6-dihydroxypyridine + H+ + NADH + O2 = 2,3,6-trihydroxypyridine + H2O + NAD+.

Name: benzoate 4-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: benzoate + H+ + NADPH + O2 = 4-hydroxybenzoate + H2O + NADP+.

Name: 4-hydroxyphenylacetate 1-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxyphenylacetate + NADPH + H+ + O2 = homogentisate + NADP+ + H2O.

Name: 2,4-dichlorophenol 6-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,4-dichlorophenol + NADPH + H+ + O2 = 3,5-dichlorocatechol + NADP+ + H2O.

Name: cyclohexanone monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cyclohexanone + NADPH + H+ + O2 = 6-hexanolide + NADP+ + H2O.

Name: 3-hydroxybenzoate 4-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-hydroxybenzoate + H+ + NADPH + O2 = 3,4-dihydroxybenzoate + H2O + NADP+.

Name: 3-hydroxybenzoate 6-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-hydroxybenzoate + H+ + NADH + O2 = 2,5-dihydroxybenzoate + H2O + NAD+.

Name: 4-aminobenzoate 1-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-aminobenzoate + NADPH + H+ + O2 = 4-hydroxyaniline + NADP+ + H2O + CO2.

Name: 4-hydroxybenzoate 3-monooxygenase [NAD(P)H] activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxybenzoate + NAD(P)H + H+ + O2 = 3,4-dihydroxybenzoate + NAD(P)+ + H2O.

Name: anthranilate 3-monooxygenase (deaminating) activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: anthranilate + 2 H+ + NADPH + O2 = 2,3-dihydroxybenzoate + NADP+ + NH4.

Name: anthraniloyl-CoA monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-aminobenzoyl-CoA + 2 NADPH + 2 H+ + O2 = 2-amino-5-oxocyclohex-1-enecarboxyl-CoA + H2O + 2 NADP+.

Name: (S)-limonene 3-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (4S)-limonene + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = (1S,6R)-isopiperitenol + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase].

Name: (S)-limonene 6-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (4S)-limonene + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = (1S,5R)-carveol + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase].

Name: (S)-limonene 7-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (4S)-limonene + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = (4S)-perillyl alcohol + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase].

Name: pentachlorophenol monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: pentachlorophenol + NADPH + H+ + O2 = tetrachlorohydroquinone + NADP+ + chloride.

Name: 4-hydroxybenzoate 1-hydroxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxybenzoate + NADPH + H+ + O2 = hydroquinone + NADP+ + H2O + CO2.

Name: dibenzothiophene sulfone monooxygenase (NADH) activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dibenzothiophene 5,5-dioxide + FMNH2 + NADH + O2 = 2'-hydroxybiphenyl-2-sulfinate + FMN + H+ + H2O + NAD+.

Name: deethylatrazine monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 deethylatrazine + O2 = 2 CH3COCH3 + 2 deisopropyldeethylatrazine.

Name: deisopropylatrazine monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 deisopropylatrazine + O2 = 2 acetaldehyde + 2 deisopropyldeethylatrazine.

Name: atrazine N-dealkylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: atrazine + O2 + 2 H+ = deethylatrazine + acetaldehyde + H2O.

Name: camphor 5-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (+)-camphor + putidaredoxin + O2 = (+)-exo-5-hydroxycamphor + oxidized putidaredoxin + H2O.

Name: 2,5-diketocamphane 1,2-monooxygenase
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1R,4R)-bornane-2,5-dione + FMNH2 + O2 = (1R,4R)-5-oxo-1,2-campholide + FMN + H+ + H2O.

Name: alkane 1-monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: octane + reduced rubredoxin + O2 = 1-octanol + oxidized rubredoxin + H2O.

Name: 6-hydroxy pseudo-oxynicotine monooxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 6-hydroxypseudooxynicotine + O2 = 2 2,6-dihydroxypseudooxynicotine.

Name: biphenyl 2,3-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: biphenyl + NADH + H+ + O2 = (2R,3S)-3-phenylcyclohexa-3,5-diene-1,2-diol + NAD+. This reaction requires Fe2+.

Name: DDT 2,3-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,1,1-trichloro-2,2-bis-(4-chlorophenyl)ethane + O2 + 2 H+ + 2 e- = cis-2,3-dihydrodiol DDT. 1,1,1-trichloro-2,2-bis-(4-chlorophenyl)ethane is also known as DDT.

Name: naphthalene disulfonate 1,2-dioxygenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (1/2)-unsubstituted naphthalenoid-(2/1)-sulfonate + 2 H+ + 2 e- + O2 = 1,2-dihydroxynaphthalene derivative + HSO3(-). Substrates include naphthalene-1,6-disulfonate (forms 1,2-dihydroxynaphthalene-6-sulfonate), naphthalene-1-sulfonate (forms 1,2-dihydroxynaphthalene), naphthalene-2,6-disulfonate (forms 1,2-dihydroxynaphthalene-6-sulfonate) and naphthalene-2-sulfonate (forms 1,2-dihydroxynaphthalene).

Name: 4-methoxybenzoate monooxygenase (O-demethylating) activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-methoxybenzoate + AH(2) + O2 = 4-hydroxybenzoate + A + formaldehyde + H2O.

Name: ethylbenzene hydroxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: A + ethylbenzene + H2O = (S)-1-phenylethanol + AH(2).

Name: p-cymene methyl hydroxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: p-cymene + NADH + O2 = NAD+ + OH- + p-cumic alcohol.

Name: 4-cresol dehydrogenase (hydroxylating) activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-cresol + acceptor + H2O = 4-hydroxybenzaldehyde + reduced acceptor.

Name: obsolete carbonyl sulfide nitrogenase activity
Definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: carbonyl sulfide + 2 H+ + 2 e- = hydrogen sulfide + carbon monoxide.

Name: chloroethene reductive dehalogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: AH2 + chloroethene = A + chloride + ethene + H+.

Name: 1,1,1-trichloroethane reductive dehalogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,1,1-trichloroethane + 2 H+ + 2 e- = 1,1-dichloroethane + HCl.

Name: 2-chloro-N-isopropylacetanilide reductive dehalogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-chloro-N-isopropylacetanilide + H+ + 2 e- = Cl- + N-isopropylacetanilide.

Name: 2,5-dichlorohydroquinone reductive dehalogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: organohalide + 2 H+ + 2 e- = R-H + HCl. Reactants include chlorohydroquinone (forms hydroquinone) and 2,5-dichlorohydroquinone (forms chlorohydroquinone).

Name: 1,1-dichloro-2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethene dehalogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,1-dichloro-2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethene + H+ + 2 e- = Cl- + 1-chloro-2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethene. 1,1-dichloro-2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethene is also known as DDE; 1-chloro-2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethene is also known as DDMU.

Name: 2,4-dichlorophenoxyacetate dehalogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,4-dichlorophenoxyacetic acid + H+ + 2 e- = Cl- + 4-chlorophenoxyacetate.

Name: obsolete 5-chloro-2-hydroxymuconic semialdehyde dehalogenase activity
Definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: 5-chloro-2-hydroxymuconic semialdehyde + H+ + 2 e- = Cl- + 2-hydroxymuconic semialdehyde.

Name: 1,2-dichloroethene reductive dehalogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,2-dichloroethene + 2 H+ + 2 e- = HCl + vinyl chloride.

Name: pyrogallol hydroxytransferase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,2,3,5-tetrahydroxybenzene + 1,2,3-trihydroxybenzene = 1,3,5-trihydroxybenzene + 1,2,3,5-tetrahydroxybenzene.

Name: 1-phenanthrol methyltransferase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-phenanthrol + X-CH3 = X + 1-methoxyphenanthrene.

Name: thiol S-methyltransferase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + a thiol = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + a thioether.

Name: acetone carboxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetone + ATP + CO2 + 2 H2O = acetoacetate + AMP + 4 H+ + 2 phosphate.

Name: benzoyl acetate-CoA thiolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: benzoyl acetyl-CoA + CoA = acetyl-CoA + benzoyl-CoA.

Name: 3-hydroxybutyryl-CoA thiolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-hydroxy-5-oxohexanoyl-CoA + CoASH = 3-hydroxybutyryl-CoA + acetyl-CoA.

Name: 3-ketopimelyl-CoA thiolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-ketopimeloyl-CoA + CoA = glutaryl-CoA + acetyl-CoA.

Name: 9-phenanthrol UDP-glucuronosyltransferase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 9-phenanthrol + UDP-glucuronate = 9-phenanthryl-beta-D-glucuronide + UDP.

Name: 1-phenanthrol glycosyltransferase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-phenanthrol + glucose = 1-phenanthryl-beta-D-glucopyranoside + H2O.

Name: 9-phenanthrol glycosyltransferase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 9-phenanthrol + glucose = 9-phenanthryl-beta-D-glucopyranoside + H2O.

Name: 1,2-dihydroxy-phenanthrene glycosyltransferase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,2-dihydroxyphenanthrene + UDP-glucose = 2-hydroxy-1-phenanthryl-beta-D-glucopyranoside + UDP.

Name: 6-aminohexanoate transaminase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-aminohexanoate + alpha-ketoglutarate = glutamate + 6-oxohexanoate.

Name: phenol kinase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phenol + X-phosphate = XH + phenylphosphate.

Name: trans-9R,10R-dihydrodiolphenanthrene sulfotransferase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans-9R,10R-dihydrodiolphenanthrene + 2 X-SO3(-) = 2 HX + phenanthrene-9,10-dihydrodiolsulfate conjugate.

Name: 1-phenanthrol sulfotransferase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-phenanthrol + X-SO3(-) = HX + 1-phenanthrylsulfate.

Name: 3-phenanthrol sulfotransferase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-phenanthrol + X-SO3(-) = HX + 3-phenanthrylsulfate.

Name: 4-phenanthrol sulfotransferase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-phenanthrol + X-SO3(-) = HX + 4-phenanthrylsulfate.

Name: trans-3,4-dihydrodiolphenanthrene sulfotransferase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans-3,4-dihydrodiolphenanthrene + 2 X-SO3(-) = 2 HX + phenanthrene-3,4-dihydrodiolsulfate conjugate.

Name: 9-phenanthrol sulfotransferase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 9-phenanthrol + X-SO3(-) = HX + 9-phenanthrylsulfate.

Name: 2-phenanthrol sulfotransferase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-phenanthrol + X-SO3(-) = HX + 2-phenanthrylsulfate.

Name: propionate CoA-transferase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + propanoate = acetate + propanoyl-CoA.

Name: glutaconate CoA-transferase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + (E)-glutaconate = acetate + glutaconyl-1-CoA.

Name: 1-oxa-2-oxocycloheptane lactonase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-oxa-2-oxocycloheptane + H2O = 6-hydroxyhexanoate.

Name: sulfolactone hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-sulfolactone + OH- = HSO3(-) + maleylacetate.

Name: 3,4-dihydrocoumarin hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3,4-dihydrocoumarin + H2O = 3-(2-hydroxyphenyl) propionate.

Name: butyrolactone hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: butyrolactone + H2O = 4-hydroxybutanoate.

Name: 6-oxo-2-hydroxycyclohexane-1-carboxyl-CoA hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-oxo-2-hydroxycyclohexane-1-carboxyl-CoA + H2O = 3-hydroxypimeloyl-CoA.

Name: 2-ketocyclohexane-1-carboxyl-CoA hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-ketocyclohexane-1-carboxyl-CoA + H2O = pimeloyl-CoA.

Name: S-formylglutathione hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-formylglutathione + H2O = formate + glutathione + H+.

Name: 4-hydroxybenzoyl-CoA thioesterase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxybenzoyl-CoA + H2O = 4-hydroxybenzoate + CoA + H+.

Name: 2'-hydroxybiphenyl-2-sulfinate desulfinase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2'-hydroxybiphenyl-2-sulfinate + H2O = biphenyl-2-ol + sulfite.

Name: "gene dszB-encoded hydrolase activity"
Definition: "HPBS desulfinase activity")

Name: linear primary-alkylsulfatase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a primary linear alkyl sulfate ester + H2O = a primary alcohol + H+ + sulfate.

Name: epoxide hydrolase B activity
Definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the ether in chloro- or hydroxyepoxypropane to produce chloropropane diol or glycerol. Acts on R enantiomers.

Name: phenanthrene-9,10-epoxide hydrolase (9R,10R-forming) activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phenanthrene-9,10-oxide + H2O = trans-9R,10R-dihydrodiolphenanthrene.

Name: limonene-1,2-epoxide hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: limonene-1,2-epoxide + H2O = limonene-1,2-diol. Other substrates include alicyclic and 1-methyl-substituted epoxides, such as 1-methylcyclohexene oxide, indene oxide and cyclohexene oxide.

Name: epoxide hydrolase A activity
Definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the ether in chloro-, bromo- or hydroxyepoxypropane to produce a chloro- or bromopropane diol or glycerol.

Name: phenanthrene-3,4-epoxide hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phenanthrene-3,4-oxide + H2O = trans-3,4-dihydrodiolphenanthrene.

Name: phenanthrene-1,2-epoxide hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phenanthrene-1,2-oxide + H2O = trans-1,2-dihydrodiolphenanthrene.

Name: iprodione amidohydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: iprodione + OH- = 3,5-dichlorophenylcarboximide + N-isopropylcarbamate.

Name: (3,5-dichlorophenylurea)acetate amidohydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (3,5-dichlorophenylurea)acetate + OH- = 3,5-dichloroaniline + N-carboxyglycine.

Name: biuret amidohydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: biuret + H2O = urea + CO2 + NH3.

Name: 3,5-dichlorophenylcarboximide hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3,5-dichlorophenylcarboximide + OH- = (3,5-dichlorophenylurea)acetate.

Name: epsilon-caprolactam lactamase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: epsilon-caprolactam + H2O = H+ + 6-aminohexanoate.

Name: cyanuric acid amidohydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cyanurate + H2O = 1-carboxybiuret + H+.

Name: ammelide aminohydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ammelide + H2O = cyanuric acid + NH3.

Name: 2-chloro-4-hydroxy-6-amino-1,3,5-triazine aminohydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-chloro-4-hydroxy-6-amino-1,3,5-triazine + OH- = 2,4-dihydroxy-6-amino-1,3,5-triazine + Cl-.

Name: ammeline aminohydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ammeline + H2O = ammelide + NH3.

Name: deisopropylhydroxyatrazine aminohydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: deisopropylhydroxyatrazine + H2O = NH3 + 2,4-dihydroxy-6-(N'-ethyl)amino-1,3,5-triazine.

Name: 2,4-dihydroxy-6-(N'-ethyl)amino-1,3,5-triazine aminohydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,4-dihydroxy-6-(N'-ethyl)amino-1,3,5-triazine + H2O = CH3CH2NH2 + cyanuric acid.

Name: methenyltetrahydromethanopterin cyclohydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5,10-methenyl-5,6,7,8-tetrahydromethanopterin + H2O = N(5)-formyl-5,6,7,8-tetrahydromethanopterin + H+.

Name: thiocyanate hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + 2 H+ + thiocyanate = carbonyl sulfide + NH4.

Name: bromoxynil nitrilase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3,5-dibromo-4-hydroxybenzonitrile + 2 H2O = 3,5-dibromo-4-hydroxybenzoate + NH4. Involved in the bacterial degradation of the herbicide bromoxynil.

Name: aliphatic nitrilase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: R-CN + H2O = R-COOH + NH3.

Name: hydroxydechloroatrazine ethylaminohydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-(ethylamino)-2-hydroxy-6-(isopropylamino)-1,3,5-triazine + H2O = N-isopropylammelide + ethylamine.

Name: N-isopropylammelide isopropylaminohydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-isopropylammelide + H2O = cyanuric acid + isopropylamine.

Name: 2-hydroxy-6-oxohepta-2,4-dienoate hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cis,cis-2-hydroxy-6-oxohept-2,4-dienoate + OH- = cis-2-hydroxypenta-2,4-dienoate + acetate.

Name: dihydrophloroglucinol hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dihydrophloroglucinol + OH- = 3-hydroxy-5-oxohexanoate.

Name: 2-hydroxy-6-oxo-7-methylocta-2,4-dienoate hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-hydroxy-6-oxo-7-methylocta-2,4-dienoate + H2O = cis-2-hydroxypenta-2,4-dienoate + isobutyrate.

Name: 2-hydroxy-6-oxo-6-(2'-aminophenyl)hexa-2,4-dienoate hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-hydroxy-6-oxo-(2'-aminophenyl)-hexa-2,4-dienoate + H2O = 2-aminobenzoate + cis-2-hydroxypenta-2,4-dienoate.

Name: 2-hydroxy-6-oxoocta-2,4-dienoate hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-hydroxy-6-oxoocta-2,4-dienoate + H2O = H+ + propanoate + cis-2-hydroxypenta-2,4-dienoate.

Name: 6-oxo-2-hydroxy-7-(4'-chlorophenyl)-3,8,8-trichloroocta-2E,4E,7-trienoate hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-oxo-2-hydroxy-7-(4'-chlorophenyl)-3,8,8-trichloroocta-2Z,4Z,7-trienoate + H2O = 2-(4'-chlorophenyl)-3,3-dichloropropenoate + cis-2-Hydroxy-3-chloropenta-2,4-dienone + H+.

Name: 2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4-dienedioate hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2E,4Z)-2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4-dienedioate + H2O = (2E)-2-hydroxypenta-2,4-dienoate + H+ + succinate.

Name: trioxoheptanoate hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,4,6-trioxoheptanoate + H2O = acetylpyruvate + acetate.

Name: acetylpyruvate hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetylpyruvate + H2O = acetate + H+ + pyruvate.

Name: 2,6-dioxo-6-phenylhexa-3-enoate hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,6-dioxo-6-phenylhexa-3-enoate + H2O = benzoate + 2-oxopent-4-enoate.

Name: 2-hydroxymuconate-semialdehyde hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-hydroxymuconate semialdehyde + H2O = formate + 2-oxopent-4-enoate.

Name: trans-chloroacrylic acid dehalogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans-3-chloroacrylic acid + H2O = H+ + malonate semialdehyde.

Name: 1,3,4,6-tetrachloro-1,4-cyclohexadiene halidohydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alkyl halide + H2O = alcohol + HCl. Substrates are 1,3(R),4,6(R)-tetrachloro-1,4-cyclohexadiene (forms 2,4,5-trichloro-2,5-cyclohexadiene-1-ol) and 2,4,5-trichloro-2,5-cyclohexadiene-1-ol (forms 2,5-dichloro-2,5-cyclohexadiene-1,4-diol).

Name: DL-2 haloacid dehalogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trichloroacetate + 2 H2O = 3 H+ + 3 Cl- + oxalate.

Name: obsolete 2-chloro-4,6-dihydroxy-1,3,5-triazine hydrolase activity
Definition: OBSOLETE. (Was not defined before being made obsolete).

Name: dichloroacetate halidohydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dichloroacetate + H2O = 2 HCl + glyoxylate.

Name: S-triazine hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-halo or 1-pseudohalo-S-triazine = 1-hydroxy-S-triazine.

Name: cis-chloroacrylic acid dehalogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cis-3-chloroacrylic acid + H2O = H+ + HCl + malonate semialdehyde.

Name: deisopropyldeethylatrazine hydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: deisopropyldeethylatrazine + H2O = 2-chloro-4-hydroxy-6-amino-1,3,5-triazine + NH3.

Name: (S)-2-haloacid dehalogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-2-haloacid + H2O = (R)-2-hydroxyacid + halide.

Name: haloacetate dehalogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: haloacetate + H2O = glycolate + halide.

Name: haloalkane dehalogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-haloalkane + H2O = a primary alcohol + halide.

Name: 4-chlorobenzoyl-CoA dehalogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-chlorobenzoyl-CoA + H2O = 4-hydroxybenzoyl CoA + chloride.

Name: atrazine chlorohydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: atrazine + H2O = 4-(ethylamino)-2-hydroxy-6-(isopropylamino)-1,3,5-triazine + chloride + H+.

Name: cyclamate sulfohydrolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cyclohexylsulfamate + H2O = cyclohexylamine + sulfate.

Name: 2-hydroxy-3-carboxy-6-oxo-7-methylocta-2,4-dienoate decarboxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-hydroxy-3-carboxy-6-oxo-7-methylocta-2,4-dienoate = CO2 + 2-hydroxy-6-oxo-7-methylocta-2,4-dienoate.

Name: bis(4-chlorophenyl)acetate decarboxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: bis(4-chlorophenyl)acetate + H+ = CO2 + bis(4-chlorophenyl)methane. Bis(4-chlorophenyl)acetate is also known as DDA; bis(4-chlorophenyl)methane is also known as DDM.

Name: 3,5-dibromo-4-hydroxybenzoate decarboxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3,5-dibromo-4-hydroxybenzoate + H+ = CO2 + 2,6-dibromophenol.

Name: 2-hydroxyisobutyrate decarboxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-hydroxyisobutyrate + H+ = CO2 + 2-propanol.

Name: 2-hydroxy-2-methyl-1,3-dicarbonate decarboxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-hydroxy-2-methyl-1,3-dicarbonate + H+ = CO2 + L-lactate.

Name: 4,5-dihydroxyphthalate decarboxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4,5-dihydroxyphthalate = 3,4-dihydroxybenzoate + CO2.

Name: gallate decarboxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: gallate + H+ = CO2 + pyrogallol.

Name: 4-hydroxybenzoate decarboxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxybenzoate + H+ = CO2 + phenol.

Name: 5-oxopent-3-ene-1,2,5-tricarboxylate decarboxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-oxopent-3-ene-1,2,5-tricarboxylate = 2-oxohept-3-enedioate + CO2.

Name: glutaconyl-CoA decarboxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans-glutaconyl-CoA + H+ = but-2-enoyl-CoA + CO2.

Name: 2,4-dihydroxyhept-2-ene-1,7-dioate aldolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,4-dihydroxy-hept-trans-2-ene-1,7-dioate = pyruvate + succinic semialdehyde.

Name: 4-(2-carboxyphenyl)-2-oxobut-3-enoate aldolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (3E)-4-(2-carboxyphenyl)-2-oxobut-3-enoate = 2-carboxybenzaldehyde + pyruvate.

Name: benzylsuccinate synthase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: fumarate + toluene = 2-benzylsuccinate.

Name: 6-hydroxycyclohex-1-ene-1-carboxyl-CoA hydratase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-hydroxycyclohex-1-ene-1-carboxyl-CoA + H2O = 2,6-dihydroxycyclohexane-1-carboxyl-CoA.

Name: trans-4-(1'-hydroxynaphth-2'-yl)-2-oxobut-3-enoate hydratase-aldolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans-4-(1'-hydroxynaphth-2'-yl)-2-oxobut-3-enoate + H2O = pyruvate + 1-hydroxy-2-naphthaldehyde.

Name: E-phenylitaconyl-CoA hydratase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: E-phenylitaconyl-CoA + H2O = (hydroxymethylphenyl)succinyl-CoA.

Name: trans-4-[2-(3-hydroxy)-thionaphthenyl]-2-oxo-3-butenoate hydratase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: trans-4-(2-(3-hydroxy)-thionaphthenyl)-2-oxo-3-butenoate + H2O = pyruvate + 3-hydroxy-2-formylbenzothiophene.

Name: cyclohex-1-ene-1-carboxyl-CoA hydratase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cyclohex-1-ene-1-carboxyl-CoA + H2O = 2-hydroxycyclohexane-1-carboxyl-CoA.

Name: 3-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydratase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 3-hydroxy-fatty acyl-CoA = a (2E)-enoyl-CoA + H2O.

Name: trans-o-hydroxybenzylidenepyruvate hydratase-aldolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxo-3-enoate-4-benzenoid + H2O = pyruvate + benzaldehyde derivative. Substrates are (3E)-4-(5-amino-2-hydroxy-phenyl)-2-oxo-but-3-ene-1-oic-acid (forms 5-aminosalicylaldehyde) and trans-o-hydroxybenzylidenepyruvate (forms salicylaldehyde).

Name: phenylacetaldoxime dehydratase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (trans)-phenylacetaldoxime = H2O + phenylacetonitrile.

Name: 3-methyl-5-hydroxy-6-(3-carboxy-3-oxopropenyl)-1H-2-pyridon hydratase-aldolase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-methyl-5-hydroxy-6-(3-carboxy-3-oxopropenyl)-1H-2-pyridon + H2O = 2-oxobut-3-enanoate + 2,5,6-trihydroxy-3-methylpyridine.

Name: 2-hydroxyisobutyrate dehydratase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-hydroxyisobutyrate = H2O + methacrylate.

Name: 2-oxo-hept-3-ene-1,7-dioate hydratase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cis-2-oxohept-3-ene-1,7-dioate + H2O = 2,4-dihydroxy-hept-trans-2-ene-1,7-dioate.

Name: acetylene hydratase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetaldehyde = acetylene + H2O.

Name: lactoyl-CoA dehydratase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: lactoyl-CoA = acryloyl-CoA + H2O.

Name: cyanamide hydratase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: urea = cyanamide + H2O.

Name: nitrile hydratase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an aliphatic amide = a nitrile + H2O.

Name: cyclohexa-1,5-dienecarbonyl-CoA hydratase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cyclohexa-1,5-diene-1-carbonyl-CoA + H2O = 6-hydroxycyclohex-1-enecarbonyl-CoA.

Name: (hydroxyamino)benzene mutase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (hydroxyamino)benzene = 2-aminophenol.

Name: triethanolamine lyase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: triethanolamine = diethanolamine + acetaldehyde.

Name: methionine gamma-lyase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-methionine = methanethiol + NH3 + 2-oxobutanoate.

Name: 1-chloro-2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethane dehydrochlorinase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-chloro-2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethane = HCl + unsym-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethene. 1-chloro-2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethane is also known as DDMS; unsym-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethene is also known as DDNU.

Name: halohydrin hydrogen-halide-lyase A activity
Definition: Catalysis of the elimination of HCl from a chloro- or bromopropanol, yielding an epoxypropane.

Name: 1,1-dichloro-2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethane dehydrochlorinase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,1-dichloro-2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethane = HCl + 1-chloro-2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethene. 1,1-dichloro-2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethane is also known as DDD; 1-chloro-2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethene is also known as DDMU.

Name: gamma-hexachlorocyclohexane dehydrochlorinase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: gamma-hexachlorocyclohexane + HCl = 1,3(R),4(S),5(S),6(R)-pentachlorocyclohexene.

Name: 5-chloro-1,2,4-trihydroxybenzene dechlorinase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-chloro-1,2,4-trihydroxybenzene = Cl- + H+ + 2-hydroxy-1,4-benzoquinone.

Name: halohydrin hydrogen-halide-lyase B activity
Definition: Catalysis of the elimination of HCl from a chloropropanol, yielding an epoxypropane.

Name: DDT-dehydrochlorinase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,1,1-trichloro-2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethane = 1,1-dichloro-2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethylene + chloride + H+.

Name: dichloromethane dehalogenase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dichloromethane + H2O = 2 chloride + formaldehyde + 2 H+.

Name: carbon phosphorus lyase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alkylphosphonic acid = R-CH3 + phosphate. Substrates include aminomethylphosphonic acid (AMPA) (forms methylamine), dimethylphosphinic acid (forms methylphosphonic acid), glyphosate (forms sarcosine) and methylphosphonic acid (forms phosphate).

Name: alkylmercury lyase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an alkylmercury + H+ = an alkane + Hg2+.

Name: 2-hydroxy-2H-benzo[h]chromene-2-carboxylate isomerase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-hydroxy-2 H-benzo[h]chromene-2-carboxylate = cis -4-(1'-hydroxynaphth-2'-yl)-2-oxobut-3-enoate.

Name: mandelate racemase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-mandelate = (R)-mandelate.

Name: cis-4-[2-(3-hydroxy)-thionaphthenyl]-2-oxo-3-butenoate isomerase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cis-4-(2-(3-hydroxy)-thionaphthenyl)-2-oxo-3-butenoate = trans-4-(2-(3-hydroxy)-thionaphthenyl)-2-oxo-3-butenoate.

Name: 2-hydroxytetrahydrofuran isomerase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-hydroxytetrahydrofuran = 4-hydroxybutyraldehyde.

Name: 2-hydroxychromene-2-carboxylate isomerase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-hydroxychromene-2-carboxylate = (3E)-4-(2-hydroxyphenyl)-2-oxobut-3-enoate. (3E)-4-(2-hydroxyphenyl)-2-oxobut-3-enoate is also known as trans-o-hydroxybenzylidenepyruvate.

Name: styrene-oxide isomerase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: styrene oxide = phenylacetaldehyde.

Name: obsolete alpha-pinene lyase activity
Definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-pinene = limonene.

Name: pinocarveol isomerase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: pinocarveol = carveol.

Name: muconate cycloisomerase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,5-dihydro-5-oxofuran-2-acetate = cis,cis-hexadienedioate.

Name: chloromuconate cycloisomerase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-chloro-2,5-dihydro-5-oxofuran-2-acetate = 3-chloro-cis,cis-muconate.

Name: alpha-pinene-oxide decyclase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-pinene oxide = (Z)-2-methyl-5-isopropylhexa-2,5-dienal.

Name: dichloromuconate cycloisomerase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,4-dichloro-2,5-dihydro-5-oxofuran-2-acetate = 2,4-dichloro-cis,cis-muconate.

Name: obsolete perillyl-CoA synthetase activity
Definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: perillic acid + CoA-SH + ATP = H2O + ADP/AMP + mono/diphosphate + perillyl-CoA.

Name: 3-isopropenyl-6-oxoheptanoyl-CoA synthetase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (3R)-3-isopropenyl-6-oxoheptanoate + CoA-SH + ATP = H2O + ADP/AMP + mono/diphosphate + (3R)-3-isopropenyl-6-oxoheptanoyl-CoA.

Name: 2-oxo-delta3-4,5,5-trimethylcyclopentenylacetyl-CoA synthetase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxo-delta3-4,5,5-trimethylcyclopentenylacetate + ATP + CoA = AMP + diphosphate + 2-oxo-delta3-4,5,5-trimethylcyclopentenylacetyl-CoA.

Name: benzoyl acetate-CoA ligase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-oxo-3-phenylpropionate + CoA + ATP = AMP + diphosphate + benzoyl acetyl-CoA.

Name: 2,4-dichlorobenzoate-CoA ligase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2,4-dichlorobenzoate + ATP + CoASH = AMP + diphosphate + 2,4-dichlorobenzoyl-CoA.

Name: benzoate-CoA ligase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + benzoate + CoA = AMP + benzoyl-CoA + diphosphate.

Name: 4-hydroxybenzoate-CoA ligase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + 4-hydroxybenzoate + CoA = AMP + diphosphate + 4-hydroxybenzoyl-CoA.

Name: anthranilate-CoA ligase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + anthranilate + CoA = AMP + diphosphate + anthranilyl-CoA.

Name: 4-chlorobenzoate-CoA ligase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-chlorobenzoate + CoA + ATP = 4-chlorobenzoyl-CoA + AMP + diphosphate. This reaction requires magnesium and is part of the bacterial 2,4-dichlorobenzoate degradation pathway.

Name: phenyl-phosphate phosphatase/carboxylase activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-hydroxybenzoate + H+ + phosphate = CO2 + H2O + phenyl phosphate.

Name: phenanthrene-9,10-epoxide hydrolase (9S,10S-forming) activity
Definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phenanthrene-9,10-oxide + H2O = trans-9(S),10(S)-dihydrodiolphenanthrene.

Name: acetylene metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving acetylene, formula CH2CH2, the simplest of the alkynes.

Name: acrylonitrile metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving acrylonitrile, a colorless, volatile liquid with a pungent odor. Acrylonitrile is used in the production of acrylic fibers, plastics, and synthetic rubbers.

Name: adamantanone metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving adamantanone, tricyclo(3.3.1.13,7)decanone, a white crystalline solid used as an intermediate for microelectronics in the production of photoresists.

Name: alpha-pinene metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving alpha-pinene, a monoterpene that may be a significant factor affecting bacterial activities in nature. It is a major component in tea-tree oils, and gives off a piney smelling odor.

Name: 2-aminobenzenesulfonate metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving 2-aminobenzenesulfonate, aniline-o-sulfonic acid, an aromatic sulfonate used in organic synthesis and in the manufacture of various dyes and medicines.

Name: anaerobic 2-aminobenzoate metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of 2-aminobenzoate, a derivative of benzoic acid with an NH2 group attached to C2, that occurs in the absence of oxygen.

Name: 1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylate metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving 1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylate, the anion of 1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylic acid, a natural product found in plant tissues. It is a key intermediate in the biosynthesis of ethylene (ethene), a fruit-ripening hormone in plants.

Name: arsonoacetate metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving arsonoacetate, a synthetic, organic compound containing a single arsenic atom. Arsonoacetate and other arsenic containing compounds are used in agricultural applications as animal feed additives, cotton defoliants and post-emergence grass herbicides.

Name: atrazine metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving atrazine, a triazine ring-containing compound, widely used as a herbicide.

Name: benzoate metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving benzoate, the anion of benzoic acid (benzenecarboxylic acid), a fungistatic compound widely used as a food preservative; it is conjugated to glycine in the liver and excreted as hippuric acid.

Name: anaerobic benzoate metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving benzoate, the anion of benzoic acid (benzenecarboxylic acid) that occur in the absence of oxygen.

Name: benzonitrile metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving benzonitrile. Benzonitrile is used as a solvent and chemical intermediate in the pharmaceutical, dyestuffs and rubber industries. It is highly toxic and harmful in contact with skin.

Name: beta-1,2,3,4,5,6-hexachlorocyclohexane metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving beta-1,2,3,4,5,6-hexachlorocyclohexane, a halogenated organic insecticide that has been used worldwide for agriculture and public health.

Name: aerobic beta-1,2,3,4,5,6-hexachlorocyclohexane metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving beta-1,2,3,4,5,6-hexachlorocyclohexane that occur in presence of oxygen.

Name: biphenyl metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving biphenyl, a toxic aromatic hydrocarbon used as a heat transfer agent, as a fungistat in packaging citrus fruits and in plant disease control. Biphenyl can be chlorinated with 1-10 chlorine molecules to form polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs).

Name: 4-chlorobiphenyl metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving 4-chlorobiphenyl, a member of the polychlorinated biphenyl (PCB) group of compounds, a very stable group of synthetic organic compounds composed of a biphenyl nucleus with 1-10 chlorine substituents. 4-chlorobiphenyl has been used as a model substrate to investigate PCB degradation.

Name: bromoxynil metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving bromoxynil, C7H3Br2NO, a dibrominated phenol derivative with a cyano (-CN) group attached. Bromoxynil is used as a herbicide for post-emergent control of annual broadleaf weeds and works by inhibiting photosynthesis in the target plants.

Name: (+)-camphor metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving (+)-camphor, a bicyclic monoterpene ketone which is one of the major components in the leaves of common sage. Camphor exists in two enantiomers, but the (+)-isomer is more widely distributed.

Name: caprolactam metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving caprolactam, hexahydro-2h-azepin-2-one, a cyclic amide of caproic acid used in manufacture of synthetic fibers of the polyamide type. It can cause local irritation.

Name: carbazole metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving carbazole, a heterocyclic aromatic compound containing a dibenzopyrrole system that is produced during coal gasification and is present in cigarette smoke. Coal tar produced at high temperature contains an average of 1.5% carbazole. It is used widely in synthesis of dyes, pharmaceuticals, and plastics and is a suspected carcinogen.

Name: carbon tetrachloride metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving carbon tetrachloride, a toxic, carcinogenic compound which is used as a general solvent in industrial degreasing operations. It is also used as grain fumigant and a chemical intermediate in the production of refrigerants.

Name: anaerobic carbon tetrachloride metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving carbon tetrachloride, a toxic, carcinogenic compound which is used as a general solvent in industrial degreasing operations, that occur in the absence of oxygen.

Name: 4-carboxy-4'-sulfoazobenzene metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving 4-carboxy-4'-sulfoazobenzene, a sulfonated azo compound synthesized by nitro-amine condensation from sulfanilic acid and 4-nitrobenzoic acid.

Name: 3-chloroacrylic acid metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving 3-chloroacrylic acid, ClHC=CHCOOH, a chlorinated derivative of acrylic acid.

Name: 2-chloro-N-isopropylacetanilide metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving 2-chloro-N-isopropylacetanilide, an acylanide herbicide widely used to protect corn, onion, cabbage, rose bushes, and ornamental plants.

Name: cyanamide metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving cyanamide, NCNH2, a cyanide compound which has been used as a fertilizer, defoliant and in many manufacturing processes. It often occurs as the calcium salt, sometimes also referred to as cyanamide. The citrated calcium salt is used in the treatment of alcoholism.

Name: cyclohexanol metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving cyclohexanol, the monohydroxy derivative of cyclohexane. It is used as a solvent and blending agent.

Name: cyclohexylsulfamate metabolic process
Definition: The chemical reactions and pathways involving cyclohexylsulfamate, also known as cyclamic acid.
